name: Makar Sankranti / Pongal
description: Sun enters Capricorn; harvest festival across India.

name: Lohri
description: Bonfire festival marking the end of winter in North India.

name: Vasant Panchami
description: Spring festival dedicated to Goddess Saraswati.

name: Maha Shivratri
description: Great night of Lord Shiva; fasting and night vigil.

name: Holika Dahan
description: Bonfire on the eve of Holi symbolising victory of good over evil.

name: Holi
description: Festival of colours celebrating spring and Krishna lore.

name: Ugadi / Gudi Padwa
description: Lunar New Year in Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Maharashtra.

name: Chaitra Navratri Begins
description: Nine nights of Goddess worship in the Chaitra month.

name: Ram Navami
description: Birth anniversary of Lord Rama.

name: Hanuman Jayanti
description: Birth celebration of Lord Hanuman.

name: Akshaya Tritiya
description: Auspicious day for new ventures and charity.

name: Buddha Purnima
description: Birth, enlightenment, and parinirvana of Gautama Buddha.

name: Raksha Bandhan
description: Sisters tie rakhi; brothers pledge protection.

name: Janmashtami
description: Birth of Lord Krishna; fasting and midnight celebrations.

name: Ganesh Chaturthi
description: Installation of Ganesha idols; visarjan after ten days.

name: Sharad Navratri Begins
description: Nine nights of Durga worship in Ashwin month.

name: Dussehra (Vijayadashami)
description: Victory of Rama over Ravana; immersion of Durga idols.

name: Diwali
description: Festival of lights; Lakshmi Puja and Deepavali celebrations.

name: Chhath Puja
description: Sun worship on the banks of rivers, especially in Bihar.

name: Guru Purnima
description: Honouring spiritual and academic teachers.
